item.title: FDA Holds Historic Public Hearing on Psychedelic Therapies
item.dc:creator: Jack Gorsline
item.description: Researchers, veterans and patients testified for two days as the agency weighed how to regulate psychedelic-assisted therapy.
item.content:encoded:
A first for the agency

Researchers, veterans and patients testified for two days as the agency weighed how to regulate psychedelic-assisted therapy.

“This is the first time the FDA has asked the public about a whole class of drugs,” one panelist said.

  • Day one: safety monitoring
  • Day two: training of facilitators
